description: Data model for the Card Transaction Authorisation journey. Introduces two new entities: ENT-032 (CardAuthorisation) owned by SVC-011, and ENT-033 (CardSettlement) owned by SVC-011. References existing central model entities ENT-001 (Customer, SVC-001), ENT-004 (Account, SVC-001), and ENT-023 (CreditCardAccount, SVC-003). PCI DSS scope: card_number_token is the ONLY card identifier in all entities and event payloads outside the SVC-011 PCI CDE. Raw PAN is never stored outside the PCI CDE.
pci_dss_scope_statement: SVC-011 (Card Processing Service) is the PCI DSS Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) boundary for this journey. All entities defined here use card_number_token (format-preserving token from the HSM-backed tokenisation vault) as the card identifier. ENT-001 and ENT-023 also use card_number_token exclusively, consistent with DD-ENT023-01 and DD-ENT001-01.

new_entities.name: CardAuthorisation
new_entities.description: Immutable record of a single card authorisation request and its outcome. Created by SVC-011 at the point an authorisation request is received from the card network (PH-041). Updated in PH-042 with the decision outcome and processing_time_ms. The raw PAN is tokenised on ingress to SVC-011; card_number_token is the only card identifier stored on this entity. This entity is the primary audit record for PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2 (audit log of cardholder data access) and for Visa/Mastercard chargeback dispute resolution.
new_entities.capability_domain: CAP-003 (Payment Operations — Card Processing sub-capability, promoted)

fields.name: auth_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-011. Immutable. Used as correlation key across all card authorisation events (EVT-064, EVT-065, EVT-066).

fields.name: card_number_token
fields.validation_rule: Required. Format-preserving token from SVC-011's HSM-backed tokenisation vault. 16-digit format preserving (first 6 BIN digits preserved; last 4 digits preserved; middle 6 replaced with token digits). Never the raw PAN. Immutable — new token generated on card replacement or compromise.
fields.pci_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1 — PAN must be protected. card_number_token is the ONLY form of card identifier stored on this entity and transmitted in event payloads. Raw PAN is handled only within SVC-011's PCI CDE at the point of tokenisation and is never persisted on ENT-032.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Must reference an active Customer. Resolved by SVC-011 from card_number_token via the local card-to-customer mapping in the authorisation cache. Immutable.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004) for debit cards, or FK → CreditCardAccount.account_id (ENT-023) for credit cards. Resolved from card_number_token via authorisation cache.

fields.name: card_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: debit | credit. Determines which balance entity is checked (ENT-004 vs ENT-023) and which service processes post-auth balance reservation (SVC-001 vs SVC-003).

fields.name: merchant_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. Visa/Mastercard Merchant ID (MID). Max 15 characters. Alphanumeric. Must be a valid MID as received in the authorisation request from the card network.

fields.name: merchant_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Merchant name as received in the authorisation request. Max 25 characters (ISO 8583 field 43 format). Used for customer-facing transaction display and fraud rule evaluation (MCC category check).

fields.name: merchant_category_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 18245 Merchant Category Code (MCC). 4-digit numeric string. Used by fraud rule engine for MCC-based spending restrictions (e.g. gambling MCCs blocked by default).

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Transaction amount in the transaction currency. Positive, non-zero. Maximum 2 decimal places. Stored as decimal — not as string to preserve numeric integrity for settlement amount comparison.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 currency code. 3 characters (e.g. GBP, USD, EUR). If currency != GBP, the amount represents the foreign currency amount; billing_amount (GBP) is derived at settlement.

fields.name: billing_amount_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required if currency != GBP. The GBP equivalent of the transaction amount at the scheme's exchange rate at authorisation time. Used for balance reservation. Null if currency = GBP.

fields.name: auth_code
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. 6-character alphanumeric authorisation code. Required and non-null if status = approved. Null if status = declined or referred. Generated by SVC-011 on authorisation approval (PH-042). Returned to card network in the authorisation response.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_decision | approved | declined | referred. Transitions: pending_decision (PH-041) → approved | declined | referred (PH-042). Terminal states: approved, declined, referred. No transition back from a terminal state.

fields.name: decline_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required if status = declined. Enum: insufficient_funds | credit_limit_exceeded | card_blocked_lost | card_blocked_stolen | card_suspended | fraud_rule_triggered | expired_card | invalid_pin | sca_failure | do_not_honour. Null if status = approved.
fields.pci_note: decline_reason must NEVER be surfaced to the merchant or in any external-facing API response beyond the scheme-standard decline code. Specific reason is for internal audit purposes only.

fields.name: scheme_response_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8583 Field 39 / ISO 20022 equivalent action code. 2-digit string. Standard Visa/Mastercard authorisation response code (e.g. '00' = approved, '51' = insufficient funds, '05' = do not honour). Returned to card network in authorisation response.

fields.name: transaction_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring. Determines SCA exemption logic and fraud rule set applied.

fields.name: three_ds_result
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required for transaction_type = card_not_present. Enum: authenticated | attempted | not_authenticated | not_required (SCA exemption applied) | not_applicable (card_present). Null for card_present and atm_withdrawal transactions.

fields.name: sca_exemption_applied
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Non-null if SCA was not fully required. Enum: low_value_contactless | recurring_transaction | transaction_risk_analysis | merchant_initiated | null (SCA completed, no exemption). Must be recorded for FCA SCA compliance audit.

fields.name: processing_time_ms
fields.validation_rule: Required. Time in milliseconds from receipt of authorisation request to transmission of authorisation response. Must be > 0. Used for SLA monitoring (NFR-JRN011-001). Alert triggered if > 400ms (approaching 500ms limit).

fields.name: channel_country_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country where the transaction was initiated (merchant/ATM country). Used for geographic fraud rule evaluation.

fields.name: authorised_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of the authorisation decision (PH-042). Immutable after PH-042. Used for settlement matching and dispute resolution.

fields.name: request_received_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of receipt of the authorisation request from the card network (PH-041). processing_time_ms = authorised_at - request_received_at.

relationships.description: CardAuthorisation belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK. Customer identity resolved from card_number_token via SVC-011's authorisation cache.
CardAuthorisation references one Account (debit card) via account_id FK. SVC-001 uses this reference for balance reservation in PH-044.
CardAuthorisation references one CreditCardAccount (credit card) via account_id FK. SVC-003 uses this reference for credit balance reservation in PH-044.

An approved CardAuthorisation may have one CardSettlement created in PH-045. Some authorisations are never settled (expired authorisations, cancelled transactions) — the relationship is optional from CardAuthorisation's perspective.

design_decisions.decision: card_number_token is the ONLY card identifier on CardAuthorisation. Raw PAN is not persisted on ENT-032.
design_decisions.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1. Consistent with DD-ENT023-01 on CreditCardAccount. SVC-011 tokenises the raw PAN on ingress from the card scheme network; all subsequent processing within and outside SVC-011 uses card_number_token exclusively. This minimises PCI CDE scope to the tokenisation vault and the scheme host gateway interface.

design_decisions.decision: processing_time_ms is a stored field on ENT-032, not computed at query time.
design_decisions.rationale: SLA compliance evidence for Visa/Mastercard scheme rules and internal NFR-JRN011-001 monitoring. Stored at the time of authorisation to create an immutable audit record of the actual processing time. Recomputing from timestamps would be susceptible to clock drift between systems.

design_decisions.decision: decline_reason is stored on ENT-032 for internal audit purposes but is NEVER surfaced in external API responses or event payloads beyond the scheme_response_code.
design_decisions.rationale: Merchant and card network should receive only the scheme-standard decline code (scheme_response_code). Specific internal decline reasons could be exploited for card testing attacks (determining exact conditions for a decline). Internal audit trail requires the full reason for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.

new_entities.name: CardSettlement
new_entities.description: Record of the cleared and settled card transaction, created by SVC-011 in PH-045 when the end-of-day clearing file from the card scheme is processed. Links to the pre-authorised CardAuthorisation (ENT-032) via auth_id FK. The settlement_amount may differ from the original authorisation amount (gratuity, currency conversion variance at settlement rate). Stores the economics of the settlement: interchange_fee (paid to the issuing bank by the acquiring bank), scheme_fee (paid to Visa/Mastercard), and net_amount (settlement_amount minus scheme_fee).
new_entities.capability_domain: CAP-003 (Payment Operations — Card Processing sub-capability, promoted)

fields.name: settlement_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-011. Immutable.

fields.name: auth_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → CardAuthorisation.auth_id (ENT-032). Must reference an approved CardAuthorisation. Immutable.

fields.name: card_number_token
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same card_number_token as the associated ENT-032 record. Denormalised for efficient settlement reconciliation queries within SVC-011. PAN never stored.
fields.pci_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1 — denormalised for query efficiency within PCI CDE only. card_number_token is the ONLY card identifier on this entity.

fields.name: settlement_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 date. The date on which the settlement was processed. Typically T+1 from the authorisation date. Used for account statement posting and FCA BCOBS record-keeping.

fields.name: settlement_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. The final settled amount in GBP. May differ from ENT-032.billing_amount_gbp due to gratuity additions, currency fluctuation between authorisation and settlement date, or partial settlement. Must be > 0.

fields.name: interchange_fee
fields.validation_rule: Required. Interchange fee paid to the bank (as issuer) by the acquiring bank for this transaction. Calculated per Visa/Mastercard interchange schedule. Non-negative. Subject to PSR interchange cap: debit ≤ 0.2% of transaction value; credit ≤ 0.3%.

fields.name: scheme_fee
fields.validation_rule: Required. Fee charged by Visa or Mastercard for scheme participation and transaction processing. Deducted from the settlement proceeds. Non-negative.

fields.name: net_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. settlement_amount minus scheme_fee. Represents the net cash flow to the bank for this transaction. Equals: settlement_amount - scheme_fee. (interchange_fee is added to this in the bank's P&L — issuer receives interchange_fee from acquirer separately via scheme settlement.)

fields.name: scheme
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: visa | mastercard. Identifies which card scheme processed the settlement.

fields.name: settlement_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: settled | failed | disputed. settled: successful settlement; failed: clearing rejection (mismatch or scheme error — requires manual reconciliation); disputed: chargeback raised by cardholder or merchant.

fields.name: settled_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of settlement record creation. Immutable.

relationships.description: CardSettlement is the settlement record for one CardAuthorisation. FK: auth_id. Settlement amounts may differ from authorisation amounts.

design_decisions.decision: interchange_fee and scheme_fee are stored on CardSettlement as separate fields rather than computing the net_amount as the sole financial field.
design_decisions.rationale: Interchange fee and scheme fee are different economic flows: interchange is revenue to the bank (from the acquirer); scheme fee is a cost to the bank (to Visa/Mastercard). Storing them separately enables accurate P&L attribution, interchange income reporting to management, and PSR interchange cap compliance monitoring (GOV-003-R05).

design_decisions.decision: card_number_token is denormalised onto CardSettlement (in addition to being on CardAuthorisation via the auth_id FK) for query performance within the PCI CDE.
design_decisions.rationale: Settlement reconciliation queries within SVC-011 require card-level aggregation of settlement records. Denormalising card_number_token avoids a join across ENT-032 for every settlement query. This denormalisation is strictly within the PCI CDE (SVC-011) — card_number_token is never surfaced in event payloads as a result of this denormalisation.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: Customer identity is resolved by SVC-011 from card_number_token via the authorisation cache. customer_id is carried on ENT-032 (CardAuthorisation) as a FK. SVC-011 does NOT hold a copy of Customer fields — it holds only customer_id as a reference. SVC-013 uses customer_id from EVT-065 to update the cardholder's fraud behaviour model.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Account
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: Debit card balance reservation: SVC-001 consumes CardAuthorisationCompleted (EVT-065) and decrements Account.available_balance by the authorised amount (PH-044 balance reservation). Final debit posted at settlement when CardSettlementProcessed (EVT-067) is consumed.
referenced_existing_entities.mutation_description: SVC-001 mutates available_balance on receipt of EVT-065 (balance reservation) and EVT-067 (settlement debit posting). No other fields are mutated by JRN-011.

referenced_existing_entities.name: CreditCardAccount
referenced_existing_entities.usage_in_journey: Credit card balance reservation: SVC-003 consumes CardAuthorisationCompleted (EVT-065) and decrements CreditCardAccount.available_balance by the authorised amount (PH-044 balance reservation). Final debit posted at settlement when CardSettlementProcessed (EVT-067) is consumed. Note: ENT-023 already documents available_balance as a cached field updated on each transaction (DD-ENT023-03) — JRN-011 is the primary journey that exercises this design decision.
referenced_existing_entities.mutation_description: SVC-003 mutates available_balance on receipt of EVT-065 (balance reservation) and EVT-067 (settlement posting). The available_balance cache on ENT-023 is the primary input to SVC-011's local balance check during PH-042.
referenced_existing_entities.cross_reference: ENT-023.design_decisions.DD-ENT023-03 explicitly anticipates JRN-011 as the consumer of this cached balance design.

entity_extensions.name: CreditCardAccount
entity_extensions.extension_description: JRN-011 triggers the addition of source_journeys: ['JRN-008', 'JRN-011'] to ENT-023. No new fields added — ENT-023 already includes all fields required for card authorisation. JRN-011 exercises the available_balance cache (DD-ENT023-03) and card_number_token (DD-ENT023-01) fields that were designed for this journey.

new_relationships.description: CreditCardAccount is the account against which CardAuthorisation transactions are made. Relationship accessed via account_id FK on ENT-032.

entity_extensions.name: Account
entity_extensions.extension_description: JRN-011 triggers addition of source_journeys: ['JRN-001', 'JRN-002', 'JRN-011'] to ENT-004. No new fields added.

new_relationships.description: Account (debit card) is the account against which debit CardAuthorisation transactions are made. Relationship accessed via account_id FK on ENT-032.
